newsitem.title: UK: Natl Express announces details on ScotRail.
newsitem.headline: Natl Express announces details on ScotRail.

text.p: British transport operator National Express said on Tuesday that it would be receiving an average annual subsidy of 237.5 million stg for the seven year franchise for ScotRail Railways Ltd.
National Express said it would receive 280.1 million stg for the franchise in the first year declining to 202.5 million in 2003/4.
ScotRail provides most of the passenger rail services in Scotland.

According to the terms of agreement between National Express and the Office of Passenger Rail Franchising and British Railways Board, National Express would acquire ScotRail for a nominal consideration.
A total funding of 21 million stg would be provided by National Express in support of ScotRail under the franchise agreement.

The funding would comprise a performance bond of 10.5 million stg, a capital subscription of 0.1 million stg and a holding company guarantee of 10.4 million stg. Completion of funding is expected by April 1, 1997.
